facts.en: Completed a building-services diploma at Fictional Copperleaf College in 2022.
facts.zh: 2022 年在虚构铜叶学院完成建筑设备文凭课程。

facts.en: Paid facilities records assistant at Fictional Cedar Loom Hall from 2023-01 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2023-01 至 2026-08 在虚构雪松织艺馆任有薪设施记录助理。

facts.en: Entered monthly electricity meter readings and linked them to invoices for the hall.
facts.zh: 录入该馆每月电表读数，并将其与发票关联。

facts.en: Checked meter identifiers and escalated unreadable readings to the facilities supervisor.
facts.zh: 检查电表编号，并将无法辨认的读数上报设施主管。

facts.en: Supported a lighting-timer trial in 2025-04; a qualified contractor changed the timer settings.
facts.zh: 2025-04 协助照明定时器试用；定时器设置由合资格承包商修改。

facts.en: Personally assembled the before-and-after meter table and retained the original invoice copies.
facts.zh: 个人整理前后电表数据表，并保留原始发票副本。

facts.en: Recorded electricity use was 1100 kWh in 2025-03 and 900 kWh in 2025-04 for the same meter.
facts.zh: 同一电表记录的用电量为 2025-03 的 1100 千瓦时及 2025-04 的 900 千瓦时。

facts.en: At the unchanged energy rate of 0.15 fictional credits per kWh, the energy-only charge was 165 credits in 2025-03 and 135 credits in 2025-04.
facts.zh: 在每千瓦时 0.15 虚构货币单位的能源单价不变时，仅能源费用为 2025-03 的 165 单位及 2025-04 的 135 单位。

facts.en: The observed monthly energy-charge difference was 30 fictional credits; fixed fees were excluded.
facts.zh: 观察到的每月能源费用差额为 30 虚构货币单位；不含固定费用。

facts.en: Prepared a 360-credit annualized scenario by multiplying the 30-credit monthly difference by 12; the scenario assumes that difference recurs each month.
facts.zh: 将 30 单位月差额乘以 12，编制 360 单位的年化情景估算；该情景假设每月重复出现该差额。

facts.en: The records contain no full-year post-trial result, and the comparison was not adjusted for occupancy, weather or month length.
facts.zh: 记录中无试用后完整年度结果，且比较未按使用人数、天气或月份天数进行调整。

facts.en: Added assumptions and exclusions to the cost worksheet for supervisor review.
facts.zh: 在成本工作表中加入假设及排除项，供主管审核。

facts.en: Uses spreadsheet formulas, filters and cell comments to maintain meter records.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格公式、筛选及单元格批注维护电表记录。

facts.en: Filed maintenance tickets after supervisor approval; did not select contractors or approve spending.
facts.zh: 经主管批准后归档维护工单；不选择承包商或批准支出。

facts.en: Completed an internal invoice-reading workshop in 2024; no energy-auditor credential was issued.
facts.zh: 2024 年完成内部发票阅读培训；未获得能源审计员资格。

facts.en: Created a personal practice dashboard using invented water readings in 2025; it was not used at the hall.
facts.zh: 2025 年使用虚构用水读数制作个人练习仪表板；该馆未使用。

facts.en: Volunteered to label tool drawers at Fictional Patch Shed in 2023-06, without carrying out electrical work.
facts.zh: 2023-06 在虚构补缀工棚志愿标记工具抽屉，未进行电气作业。

facts.en: Wrote a handover note explaining missing-reading flags and where to find invoice copies.
facts.zh: 编写交接备注，说明缺失读数标记及发票副本存放位置。

facts.en: Enjoys building cardboard architectural models.
facts.zh: 爱好制作纸板建筑模型。

facts.en: No independent energy-audit sign-off authority is documented.
facts.zh: 未记录独立签署能源审计结论的权限。
